changeSet.sql: WITH business_text AS ( SELECT b.id, lower( concat_ws( ' ', b.name, b.description, b.address_line, b.city, string_agg(coalesce(os.name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(os.description, ''), ' ') ) ) AS text_value FROM public.businesses b LEFT JOIN public.offered_services os ON os.business_id = b.id WHERE b.category = 'OTHER' GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.description, b.address_line, b.city ) UPDATE public.businesses b SET category = CASE WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(sartarosh|barber|barbershop|soch|hair|haircut)' THEN 'BARBER' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(go''zallik|gozallik|beauty|makeup|kosmetik|spa|nail|tirnoq|massaj)' THEN 'BEAUTY' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(tibbiyot|medical|clinic|klinika|doktor|stomatolog|shifokor)' THEN 'MEDICAL' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(ta''mir|tamir|repair|usta|servis|telefon|kompyuter)' THEN 'REPAIR' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(konsult|consult|maslahat)' THEN 'CONSULTING' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(ta''lim|talim|education|kurs|o''quv|oquv|ustoz)' THEN 'EDUCATION' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(sport|fitness|gym|trenajor|murabbiy)' THEN 'FITNESS' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(avto|auto|mashina|car|avtoservis)' THEN 'AUTO' WHEN bt.text_value ~ '(yuridik|legal|advokat|huquq)' THEN 'LEGAL' ELSE b.category END FROM business_text bt WHERE b.id = bt.id;
